shape_notes: All families share: Eq, Neq, In, NotIn, IsNull, IsNotNull
Numeric families (Number, Time) add: Gt, Gte, Lt, Lte
String adds: Like, ILike, NotLike, NotILike
Slice (JSON columns, PostgreSQL arrays) adds: Contains, ContainedBy, Overlap

composition.nesting: And and Or nest arbitrarily; default is AND across top-level fields
composition.or: Filter.Or:  []*Filter — entries OR'd together; each entry's own fields are AND'd, so a union is one entry per branch

omittable.purpose: Distinguishes 'not set' from 'set to zero value'. Used in <Entity>Update structs and partial-update contexts.
omittable.json_behavior: Marshals to the wrapped value when set; omitted when unset (omitzero semantics on the wrapper, via IsZero)

entities.name: CategoryStat
entities.source:
-- @type product_count: int32
-- @nullable: category_name

CREATE VIEW category_stats AS
SELECT
    c.name AS category_name,
    COUNT(p.id) AS product_count,
    SUM(p.price) AS total_price,
    AVG(p.price) AS avg_price,
    MIN(p.price) AS min_price,
    MAX(p.price) AS max_price,
    GROUP_CONCAT(p.title, ', ') AS product_names
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name;

entities.name: ProductSummary
entities.source:
-- @pk: id
-- @type order_count: int32
-- @nullable: title

CREATE VIEW product_summary AS
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.title,
    p.price,
    c.name AS category_name,
    COUNT(oi.id) AS order_count
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.price, c.name;

mutation.notes: Batched in generation.batch_size chunks over the same UserCategoryConflictTarget enum Upsert takes. mutation.name: Update
mutation.notes: Only fields where IsSet() reports true reach the SET clause; an input with none set issues no UPDATE and returns the row unchanged.

mutation.name: UpdateMany
mutation.notes: Issues one statement per item. Batched like CreateMany — earlier items are not rolled back on a later failure. A primary key that does not exist is silently skipped, even under strict_updates.

mutation.name: UpdateWhere
mutation.notes: Idempotent — returns an empty slice when no row matches. ErrEmptyFilter when the filter produces no conditions.
